subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: After the four stale assertions are fixed and exact-head checks pass, should the security owners approve these credential-bearing GitHub Action updates as one grouped dependency change?
rationale: The assertion repair is mechanical and upstream tag provenance is verified, but accepting updated third-party action code in token, registry, release, agent, and code-scanning workflows requires explicit security-owner intent.

options.title: Approve the verified group
options.body: Accept all verified immutable revisions together after focused guards and exact-head checks pass.

options.title: Split sensitive actions
options.body: Separate token, registry, Codex, Docker, and CodeQL updates for narrower supply-chain review.

options.title: Pause the update
options.body: Keep the existing pins if the grouped privileged revisions cannot be approved now.

recommendation.title: Approve the verified group
recommendation.body: Accept all verified immutable revisions together after focused guards and exact-head checks pass.

likelyOwner.reason: This team is the explicit CODEOWNER for the security workflows and dependency-guard contract changed by the PR.
